summary: IceCure Medical Ltd. filed a Form 6-K disclosing a private placement via a Securities Purchase Agreement with an institutional investor. The company will issue pre-funded warrants to purchase 1,833,334 ordinary shares at $0.0001 per share, along with Series D warrants (five-year term) and Series E warrants (one-year term) each exercisable at $3.00 per share, for a combined purchase price of $2.9999 per unit. Gross proceeds are approximately $5.5 million, with closing expected on or about June 18, 2026. Existing Series B and C warrants were amended to reduce exercise price to $3.00 and extend terms, subject to shareholder approval. A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners served as placement agent.
